description.zh:
域名名称。<props="china">可通过调取[DescribeDomains](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)接口获取</props>
<props="intl">可通过调取[DescribeDomains](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)接口获取</props>
description.en: The domain name. You can call the [DescribeDomains](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d\_0) operation to obtain the domain name.

description.zh:
域名类型，取值：

- PUBLIC：权威托管域名（默认值）

- CACHE：权威代理域名
description.en:
The type of the domain name. Valid values:

*   PUBLIC (default): hosted public domain name
*   CACHE: cached public domain name

description.zh:
查询的结束时间，格式：**YYYY-MM-DD**。

默认为查询当天的时间。
description.en:
The end date of the query. Specify the end date in the **YYYY-MM-DD** format.

The default value is the day when you query the data.

description.zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。
- **zh**（默认）：中文
- **en**：英文
description.en:
The language of the content within the request and response.

*   **zh**: Chinese (default)
*   **en**: English

description.zh:
查询的开始时间，格式：**YYYY-MM-DD**。

只能查询最近90天的记录，即：`StartDate >= Now - 90`。
description.en:
The start date of the query. Specify the start date in the **YYYY-MM-DD** format.

You can only query the DNS records within the last 90 days.``

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns describe-domain-statistics --lang en --domain-name example.com --start-date 2019-07-04 --end-date 2019-07-04 --domain-type PUBLIC --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns DescribeDomainStatistics --region cn-hangzhou --StartDate '2019-07-04' --DomainType PUBLIC --DomainName 'example.com' --Lang en --EndDate '2019-07-04'
